notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls five or more artifacts.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent that controls five or more artifacts using Cavern-Hoard Dragon.
Cavern-Hoard Dragon triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat until no opponent controls five or more artifacts.
